product_from_film: Perplexity Computer runs multi-step research and creation tasks, returns files and apps, and sets up follow-up monitoring.
explains_well: Three examples show explicit requests followed by distinct outputs: a model and web app, a captioned clip, and a property model with monitoring.
unclear: The first example asks many things at once, while the outputs move too quickly to trace one source or change through the finished model.
scenario: Research Nvidia, update a financial model, make a short video and monitor a property bid
product_clear_basis: Detailed model-update and web-app request establishes multi-step execution.

lessons.keep: Keep explicit prompts, concrete artifacts and follow-up scheduling.
try: Trace one analyst estimate into a labelled workbook row with old/new values and its source.
Shorten the final breadth montage and use that time to hold one complete output at readable scale.
lessons.avoid: Avoid cropping away metric names while asking viewers to appreciate highlighted model changes.
lessons.open: Audio is unheard. Financial conclusions, data quality, generation speed and monitoring outcomes remain unverified.
